## Metadata of in-situ equipment at surface water sites {#sec-ds-surf-meta}

- Numerical; Text (English)
- Adding new data to an existing dataset (the Aqua Chem and Watina SQL Server database). Data are updated frequently (e.g. daily). Added data is verified.
- Includes properties of in-situ equipment for interpretation & equipment management, such as spatial position (3D) of the water level gauge.
- Collection expected to run from 2026 to 2050 and exclusively by INBO
- Backup strategy: monthly data dumps to cloud storage such as Google Drive, and to local digital storage (physical hard drives).
- Publishing strategy: planned to be published openly as soon as possible. Releases are made less frequently (e.g. yearly) to Zenodo.
- Expected to include ongoing/continuous data revision/addition and yearly updating of dataset until (at least) 2050.
